summary: Burtech Acquisition Corp II, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K announcing that from July 14, 2026, unit holders may elect to separately trade the underlying Class A ordinary shares and warrants on Nasdaq. This is a routine administrative step following the May 21, 2026 IPO. There are no special-situation elements such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review. The filing does not involve a deal, tender offer, or any event that alters the company's structure beyond enabling separate trading of securities. No additional terms or advisors are disclosed. This is a standard post-IPO notification.
